sourceLabel: 原创模拟题与参考范文

essays.title: 邀请外教参加英语角
essays.prompt: 假定你是李华。学校英语角将举行一次交流活动，请给外教 Ms. Green 写一封邮件，说明活动的时间、地点和主题，邀请她担任嘉宾，并询问她是否有空。正文约 80 词。
outline: 开门见山说明邀请目的，交代活动时间和地点。
介绍英语角的主题与安排，说明希望外教做什么。
礼貌询问对方是否有空，并表示期待回复。

paragraphs.english: I am writing to invite you to join our school’s English Corner as a guest.
paragraphs.meaning: 我写信是想邀请您参加我们学校的英语角并担任嘉宾。

paragraphs.english: We will all meet in the school library at four this Friday afternoon.
paragraphs.meaning: 我们会一起集合，地点在学校图书馆，时间是本周五下午四点。

paragraphs.english: Our topic is how to make new students feel welcome.
paragraphs.meaning: 我们的主题是如何让新同学感受到大家的欢迎。

paragraphs.english: We hope you can share a short story before we discuss the topic in small groups.
paragraphs.meaning: 我们希望您能先分享一个小故事，然后我们分组讨论这个话题。

paragraphs.english: Your advice would help us speak with more confidence.
paragraphs.meaning: 您的建议会帮助我们更自信地开口表达。

paragraphs.english: Could you let me know whether you are free to join us?
paragraphs.meaning: 您能告诉我是否有空参加这次活动吗？

essays.title: 给校学生会的阅读建议
essays.titleEnglish: A Suggestion for the School Reading Program
essays.prompt: 假定你是李华。校学生会正在征集改进校园阅读活动的建议，请写一封邮件，提出一项可行建议，说明组织方式，并解释它能给同学带来什么好处。正文约 80 词。
outline: 回应征集并提出每周设置午间阅读时段。
具体说明时间、地点和同学参与的方式。
解释活动的好处，建议先试行。

paragraphs.english: I would like to suggest a short reading break at lunchtime once a week.
paragraphs.meaning: 我想建议安排一段短时阅读，每周一次，利用午间时间进行。

paragraphs.english: It could take place in the library every Wednesday after lunch.
paragraphs.meaning: 活动可以安排在每周三午饭后，在图书馆举行。

paragraphs.english: Students could bring a book of their choice or borrow one from the library.
paragraphs.meaning: 同学们可以带来自己挑选的一本书，也可以从图书馆借一本。

paragraphs.english: At the end, two volunteers could share a favorite line with the group.
paragraphs.meaning: 活动结束时，两位自愿参加的同学可以分享一句自己喜欢的话给大家听。

paragraphs.english: This simple activity would help us read regularly and discover new books.
paragraphs.meaning: 这个简单的活动能帮助我们养成经常阅读的习惯，也能让我们发现新书。

paragraphs.english: I hope we can try it for a month and ask students what they think.
paragraphs.meaning: 我希望我们可以先试行一个月，再听听同学们的意见。

essays.title: 博物馆参观通知
essays.prompt: 假定你是校英语社负责人。请代表英语社写一份参观城市博物馆的英文通知，包括集合时间和地点、主要活动、携带物品及报名方式。正文约 80 词。
outline: 说明活动的时间、地点和集合要求。
介绍听讲解、准备英文问题的任务，列出携带物品。
写明报名地点和截止时间。

paragraphs.english: The English Club will visit the city museum this Saturday morning.
paragraphs.meaning: 英语社将于本周六上午参观城市博物馆。

paragraphs.english: Please meet at the school gate at half past eight and arrive five minutes early.
paragraphs.meaning: 请大家于八点半在校门口集合，并提前五分钟到达。

paragraphs.english: A guide will show us how people in our city used to travel.
paragraphs.meaning: 讲解员会向我们介绍本市居民过去如何出行。

paragraphs.english: Bring a notebook and prepare one question in English for the guide.
paragraphs.meaning: 请带上笔记本，并准备好一个要向讲解员提问的英文问题。

paragraphs.english: If you would like to join, please sign up in the club room by Thursday afternoon.
paragraphs.meaning: 如果你想参加，请最晚于周四下午到社团活动室报名。

paragraphs.english: We look forward to exploring the museum with you.
paragraphs.meaning: 我们期待和你一起参观博物馆。

essays.title: 感谢寄宿家庭的照顾
essays.titleEnglish: A Thank-You Letter to a Host Family
essays.prompt: 假定你是李华，刚结束交流访问。请给寄宿家庭的 Brown 夫妇写一封邮件，感谢他们的照顾，回忆一两件令你印象深刻的小事，并邀请他们有机会来中国。正文约 80 词。
outline: 感谢寄宿家庭让自己感受到家的温暖。
用等自己表达和一起做饭的细节说明感谢的原因。
邀请对方来中国，希望保持联系。

paragraphs.english: Thank you for making me feel at home during my visit.
paragraphs.meaning: 谢谢你们让我在访问期间感受到家的温暖。

paragraphs.english: On my first evening, I was too nervous to talk much, but you waited patiently.
paragraphs.meaning: 到达的第一晚，我紧张得说不出多少话，但你们耐心地等我。

paragraphs.english: I also enjoyed making dinner with you and learning the names of different vegetables.
paragraphs.meaning: 我也很喜欢和你们一起做晚饭，顺便学习不同蔬菜的英文名称。

paragraphs.english: By the end of the week, I felt much more comfortable speaking English at the table.
paragraphs.meaning: 到那周结束时，我已经能更自在地在饭桌上用英语聊天了。

paragraphs.english: If you ever visit China, I would love to show you around my hometown.
paragraphs.meaning: 如果你们有机会来中国，我很愿意带你们逛逛我的家乡。

paragraphs.english: Let us keep in touch and share more stories.
paragraphs.meaning: 让我们保持联系，继续分享更多故事吧。

essays.title: 社区公园志愿活动报道
essays.titleEnglish: Students Lend a Hand at the Local Park
essays.prompt: 假定你是校英文报小记者。上周六同学们参加了社区公园志愿活动，请写一篇短报道，交代活动时间和参与者，说明活动中的志愿任务及成效。正文约 80 词。
outline: 用导语交代志愿活动的时间、地点和参与人数。
按任务分工介绍捡垃圾、分类和绘制提示牌。
写出活动成效与后续安排。

paragraphs.english: Last Saturday, nearly thirty students from our school volunteered at the local park.
paragraphs.meaning: 上周六，我校近三十名学生在社区公园参加了志愿活动。

paragraphs.english: Working in groups, they picked up litter along the paths and sorted it for recycling.
paragraphs.meaning: 他们分组行动，捡拾步道沿线的垃圾，并进行分类，以便回收。

paragraphs.english: Some students also made signs to remind visitors to take their rubbish home.
paragraphs.meaning: 一些同学还制作了提示牌，提醒游客把自己的垃圾带走。

paragraphs.english: By noon, the paths were cleaner, and several visitors had stopped to thank the students.
paragraphs.meaning: 到中午时，步道比之前干净了，还有几位游客停下来向同学们道谢。

paragraphs.english: A park worker said the new signs would be put up near the entrances.
paragraphs.meaning: 一位公园工作人员表示，新提示牌会安放在各入口附近。

paragraphs.english: The school plans to organize another visit next month.
paragraphs.meaning: 学校计划下个月再组织一次志愿活动。

essays.title: 绿色校园主题发言
essays.titleEnglish: Small Steps for a Greener School
essays.prompt: 假定你是李华。你将在学校环保周启动活动上用英语发言。请指出你在校园中发现的一个问题，给出两个同学们能做到的建议，并发出行动倡议。正文约 80 词。
outline: 从教室无人时仍亮灯的现象引出主题。
建议离开教室前关灯，午餐时带上可重复使用的水瓶。
说明个人小行动的意义，邀请同学们从今天做起。

paragraphs.english: Last week, I noticed that lights were still on in several empty classrooms.
paragraphs.meaning: 上周，我注意到好几间没人的教室还开着灯。

paragraphs.english: Saving energy at school can begin with a simple habit.
paragraphs.meaning: 节约能源在校园里可以从一个简单的习惯做起。

paragraphs.english: Before you leave a classroom, check whether the lights need to be turned off.
paragraphs.meaning: 离开教室前，请检查一下是否需要关灯。

paragraphs.english: At lunchtime, bring a reusable bottle instead of buying a plastic one.
paragraphs.meaning: 午餐时，带上可反复使用的水瓶，就不用再买一次性的塑料瓶了。

paragraphs.english: Each action may seem small, but together our choices can make a difference.
paragraphs.meaning: 每个行动可能看起来很小，但汇聚在一起，我们的选择就能带来改变。

paragraphs.english: Let us start today and work together to make our school a greener place.
paragraphs.meaning: 让我们从今天做起，一起努力，让校园变得更环保。

essays.title: 辩论伙伴之间的误会
essays.prompt: 阅读下面的故事，根据故事内容和所给段首句续写两段，使其构成一篇完整短文。续写约 150 词。
outline: 第一段解释笔记上的问号，化解误会，用共同修改的行动恢复合作。
第二段照应原文中“用事实说明问题”的线索，交代辩论中的表现和友谊的变化。

reading.english:
Our English teacher announced a class debate on whether the school should keep its library open later. My partner, Emma, usually came up with ideas quickly, while I liked to collect facts before deciding what to say. We agreed that she would introduce our position and I would explain why the change would help students who had a long journey home.

At lunchtime the day before the debate, I spread our notes across an empty desk. I had talked to just four students, but one line in our speech said that most students needed more time in the library. I circled the line and put a question mark beside it. I was about to write a suggestion under it when the librarian asked me to help return some books.

When I came back, Emma was standing by the desk. Her own notes were already in her bag. She said she could do the whole debate alone if I did not trust her work. Before I could explain, the bell rang and she left. Later that afternoon, I found our planning sheet under a book. At the top, in Emma’s handwriting, were the words “Use facts, not guesses.” I had been so busy worrying about the speech that I had forgotten this was her idea too. I folded the sheet, put it in my pocket and went to see her.
reading.summary: 我和艾玛一起准备一场关于延长图书馆开放时间的辩论。因为采访人数太少，我在讲稿里一句涉及“多数学生”的话旁画了问号。艾玛误以为我不信任她，提出独自完成辩论。后来我看到她写下的准备原则，意识到我们其实有共同的目标，于是去找她解释。

paragraphStarts.english: I found Emma sitting alone outside the classroom.
paragraphStarts.meaning: 我发现艾玛独自坐在教室外。

paragraphStarts.english: The next morning, we walked to the front of the classroom together.
paragraphStarts.meaning: 第二天早晨，我们一起走到教室前面。

paragraphs.english: I sat beside her and showed her the planning sheet she had left under the book.
paragraphs.meaning: 我在她身边坐下，给她看了她落在书底下的准备提纲。

paragraphs.english: I told her the question mark was about the claim, and apologized for leaving my note unfinished.
paragraphs.meaning: 我告诉她问号针对的是那条说法，并为没把留言写完而道歉。

paragraphs.english: Emma read the line again and admitted that four interviews were not enough to speak for everyone.
paragraphs.meaning: 艾玛又读了一遍那句话，也承认只采访四个人不足以代表所有同学。

paragraphs.english: We decided to keep one student’s story and say clearly how many people we had asked.
paragraphs.meaning: 我们决定保留一位同学的故事，也说清楚我们实际采访了多少人。

paragraphs.english: By the time we finished, Emma was adding ideas to my notes again.
paragraphs.meaning: 等修改完时，艾玛又在我的笔记里补充她的想法了。

paragraphs.english: Emma gave our opening, and I described what one student did while waiting for her bus.
paragraphs.meaning: 艾玛作了开场陈述，我则讲述了一位同学等公交车时做了些什么。

paragraphs.english: When a classmate asked whether our example was unusual, we explained the limits of our survey.
paragraphs.meaning: 有位同学问这个例子是不是个例，我们解释了调查的局限。

paragraphs.english: Our teacher praised us for making a careful argument with limited evidence.
paragraphs.meaning: 老师表扬了我们，因为我们做到了用有限的证据提出审慎的论点。

paragraphs.english: As we packed our notes, Emma drew another question mark beside a line on my page.
paragraphs.meaning: 收拾笔记时，艾玛又在我笔记里的一句话旁画了一个问号。

paragraphs.english: This time I asked what she meant, and we both smiled.
paragraphs.meaning: 这次我问她是什么意思，我们都笑了。

essays.title: 暴雨中的旅途互助
essays.titleEnglish: A Place Out of the Rain
essays.prompt: 阅读下面的故事，根据故事内容和所给段首句续写两段，使其构成一篇完整短文。续写约 150 词。
outline: 第一段接续暴雨、末班车和湿掉的地图，写出如何看懂售票亭时刻表并找到遮雨处。
第二段用游客寄来的明信片写互助的回响，照应原文中的蓝门和雨伞。

reading.english:
Last summer, my cousin and I took a day trip to a small town by the sea. We spent the afternoon looking at old fishing boats and taking pictures of the brightly painted doors. The town had only one bus stop, outside a closed ticket office. My cousin checked our return time before we left the harbor, because the last bus was due shortly after six.

Just as we reached the main street, the sky turned dark. Rain hit the pavement so hard that we could hardly hear each other. We opened our umbrella and hurried towards the bus stop. On the way, we noticed a woman and a little girl standing under a thin tree. The woman was turning a wet paper map over and over. She pointed to a picture of the train station and asked whether they should walk along the shore to get there.

I thought our bus went past the station, but I did not want to send them to the wrong place. My phone had almost no charge, and water was running down the screen. Across the street, I could see a little shop with a blue door and a deep roof over the entrance. A few steps beyond it was the old ticket office. A timetable was still pinned behind its glass, though the writing was too small to read from where we stood. My cousin looked at the two travelers, then handed me the umbrella.
reading.summary: 我和表亲到海边小镇游玩。回程时突降暴雨，我们遇到一名想去火车站的游客和一个小女孩。她们的纸质地图湿了，我的手机又快没电。街对面有一家蓝门小店可以遮雨，附近的旧售票亭玻璃后仍贴着公交时刻表。

paragraphStarts.english: I held the umbrella over them and pointed to the blue door.
paragraphStarts.meaning: 我给她们撑起伞，指了指那扇蓝门。

paragraphStarts.english: A week later, I found a postcard in my mailbox.
paragraphStarts.meaning: 一周后，我在自家信箱里发现了一张明信片。

paragraphs.english: They followed me across the street, and we waited together under the roof of the shop.
paragraphs.meaning: 她们跟我穿过街道，我们一起等在小店的屋檐下。

paragraphs.english: While my cousin stayed with them, I ran to the ticket office and checked the timetable.
paragraphs.meaning: 表亲留下陪她们，我跑到售票亭查看时刻表。

paragraphs.english: The last bus did stop at the station, and we still had ten minutes before it arrived.
paragraphs.meaning: 末班车确实会停靠火车站，而且再过十分钟它就到站了。

paragraphs.english: On the bus, the woman asked for my address, saying her daughter wanted to send me something.
paragraphs.meaning: 上车后，那位女士问了我的地址，说她女儿想寄点东西给我。

paragraphs.english: When they got off, the girl waved until the bus turned the corner.
paragraphs.meaning: 她们下车后，女孩一直挥手，直到公交车拐过街角。

paragraphs.english: On the front was a drawing of the little shop with its bright blue door.
paragraphs.meaning: 明信片正面画着那家有亮蓝色门的小店。

paragraphs.english: Under the roof, four people stood close together while rain fell in thick blue lines.
paragraphs.meaning: 屋檐下，四个人挨在一起，雨水被画成一道道粗粗的蓝线。

paragraphs.english: The girl wrote that they had caught their train and were safely home.
paragraphs.meaning: 女孩写道，她们赶上了火车，已经平安到家。

paragraphs.english: I showed the card to my cousin, who laughed at the enormous umbrella in the drawing.
paragraphs.meaning: 我把明信片拿给表亲看，画上那把大得出奇的伞把表亲逗笑了。

paragraphs.english: We kept it as a reminder of what a small act of help can mean.
paragraphs.meaning: 我们把它留了下来，让它提醒我们，一点小小的帮助也可以很有意义。

essays.title: 科技展上的临时修理
essays.prompt: 阅读下面的故事，根据故事内容和所给段首句续写两段，使其构成一篇完整短文。续写约 150 词。
outline: 第一段利用包装纸板修补坡道，写出协作和一次有效的试验。
第二段用参观者提问呈现修理后的设计，解释小组从意外中获得的认识。

reading.english:
For our school science fair, three classmates and I built a model to show how rainwater could be collected from a roof. Water from a small cup ran down a flat plastic ramp and into a bottle. A second bottle caught the water that was left over. We wanted visitors to see how a slight change in the angle of the ramp could make a big difference.

On the morning of the fair, we carried the model to the sports hall in a cardboard box. While we were setting up, someone bumped the end of our table. The ramp slid off and broke against the floor. We had packed extra tape and another bottle, but there was no spare ramp. Our demonstration was due to begin in forty minutes.

One group member wanted to put a sign on the table saying that the model was out of order. Another suggested showing the drawings and explaining what would have happened. I could see why they were worried, because the ramp had taken most of an afternoon to make. Then I noticed that our cardboard box had a smooth panel at the bottom. There was also a roll of wide clear tape on the table. In our first trial at school, the teacher had asked whether the same idea would work with cheaper materials. We had been too busy making our model look neat to find out. Now we had a reason to try.
reading.summary: 科技展上，小组的集雨模型被撞坏，塑料坡道断裂。离演示只剩四十分钟，同学们不知道是取消演示还是改用图示。我看见包装纸板和透明胶带，想起老师曾问过：能不能用更便宜的材料达到同样的效果？

paragraphStarts.english: I picked up the box and asked my classmates to give it a try.
paragraphStarts.meaning: 我拿起盒子，请同学们一起试一试。

paragraphStarts.english: When the first visitors arrived, a younger student stopped at our table.
paragraphStarts.meaning: 第一批参观者到来时，一名低年级学生在我们桌前停了下来。

paragraphs.english: One teammate cut out a panel while another covered its surface with strips of clear tape.
paragraphs.meaning: 一位队友裁下一块纸板，另一位在板面上贴好一条条透明胶带。

paragraphs.english: I bent the sides upwards so water would stay on the ramp as it flowed down.
paragraphs.meaning: 我把两侧向上折起，这样水就会留在坡道上，顺着它往下流。

paragraphs.english: Our first test sent water past the mouth of the bottle and onto the table.
paragraphs.meaning: 第一次试验时，水越过了瓶口，流到了桌面上。

paragraphs.english: We lowered one end and tried again after moving the bottle slightly to the left.
paragraphs.meaning: 我们把其中一端放低，把瓶子往左挪了一点再试。

paragraphs.english: This time the water went straight into the bottle, and we all cheered.
paragraphs.meaning: 这次水直接流进了瓶子，我们都欢呼起来。

paragraphs.english: He pointed at the ramp and asked why we had chosen to make it from cardboard.
paragraphs.meaning: 他指着坡道，问我们为什么选择用纸板来做。

paragraphs.english: Instead of hiding the broken piece, I showed him what had happened earlier that morning.
paragraphs.meaning: 我没有把断掉的零件藏起来，而是拿给他看，解释了当天上午的意外。

paragraphs.english: My teammate let him change the angle of the ramp before pouring another cup of water.
paragraphs.meaning: 我的队友让他调整坡道的角度，然后又倒了一杯水。

paragraphs.english: Watching the water move, he said he could build a model like ours at home.
paragraphs.meaning: 看着水流动，他说他在家也能做一个这样的模型。

paragraphs.english: That was when we realized our repair had made the idea easier to share.
paragraphs.meaning: 那时我们才意识到，这次修理让这个点子更容易和别人分享。

essays.title: 帮新同学找回素描本
essays.prompt: 阅读下面的故事，根据故事内容和所给段首句续写两段，使其构成一篇完整短文。续写约 150 词。
outline: 第一段用可见线索辨认素描本，通过图书管理员联系主人。
第二段由归还本子自然过渡到邀请新同学一起画画，照应原文的校门口的老树和画画活动。

reading.english:
Daniel joined our class halfway through the term. He sat in the last row and seemed happier drawing in his notebook than joining conversations during breaks. One afternoon our teacher asked us to sketch something in the schoolyard. Daniel drew the old tree by the gate. I noticed that he made each leaf with three short pencil lines, which gave the whole tree a lively shape. I wanted to talk to him about it, but I did not know how to start.

Two days later, I saw Daniel looking under his desk and checking the shelves at the back of the room. His blue sketchbook was missing. He had used it for almost a year, and it held drawings from his old school as well as his new one. I offered to help. He remembered stopping by the library after lunch the previous day, but he had already asked at the front desk and no one had turned in a book.

After the last lesson, I went to the library to return a book. From the desk I could see a blue corner sticking out from beneath a pile of magazines. I asked the librarian if we could take a look. There was no name on the cover, and several of us had blue notebooks from the same shop. When she lifted the last magazine, however, a page slipped open and I saw a familiar picture.
reading.summary: 转学生丹尼尔喜欢画画，曾用三根短线画出一片片树叶。我想和他聊聊，却一直没找到开口的机会。后来丹尼尔丢了一本画满回忆的蓝色素描本。我在图书馆归还书籍时发现一摞杂志下露出了蓝色的一角，并看到一幅熟悉的画。

paragraphStarts.english: I recognized the old tree as soon as I saw the leaves.
paragraphStarts.meaning: 一看到树叶，我立刻认出了那棵老树。

paragraphStarts.english: At lunchtime, Daniel came to find me by the school gate.
paragraphStarts.meaning: 午饭时间，丹尼尔来学校大门口找我。

paragraphs.english: I told the librarian about the drawing lesson and the way Daniel made his leaves.
paragraphs.meaning: 我告诉图书管理员那堂绘画课的事，也说了丹尼尔是怎么画树叶的。

paragraphs.english: She agreed to keep the book at the desk until we could ask him to identify it.
paragraphs.meaning: 她同意把本子暂时留在服务台，等我们请丹尼尔过来辨认。

paragraphs.english: The next morning, I told Daniel what I had seen when he arrived at school.
paragraphs.meaning: 第二天早上，我把看到的情况告诉了丹尼尔，那时他刚到学校。

paragraphs.english: He described another picture near the back of the book, and we checked it together at the library.
paragraphs.meaning: 他描述了画册靠后几页的另一幅画，我们就一起去图书馆核对。

paragraphs.english: The librarian smiled and handed the sketchbook back to him.
paragraphs.meaning: 图书管理员笑了，把素描本还给他。

paragraphs.english: Daniel thanked me and showed me a new drawing of the library desk he had just made.
paragraphs.meaning: 丹尼尔向我道谢，还给我看了他刚画好的图书馆服务台。

paragraphs.english: I told him that I admired his tree drawing before I ever knew how important the book was.
paragraphs.meaning: 我告诉他，我早就很喜欢他画的那棵树，当时还不知道那本画册对他有多重要。

paragraphs.english: Then I asked if he would like to draw the old tree again with me.
paragraphs.meaning: 接着我问他愿不愿意和我再画一次那棵老树。

paragraphs.english: He opened his sketchbook to a clean page and offered me a spare pencil.
paragraphs.meaning: 他打开素描本翻到空白页，递给我一支备用铅笔。

paragraphs.english: We sat under the tree and drew side by side, talking easily at last.
paragraphs.meaning: 我们坐在树下，并排画画，终于自然地聊了起来。
